post.description: Issues a short-lived, single-use WebSocket upgrade ticket. The client must be authenticated via HttpOnly cookie or Bearer token. Connect to the WebSocket endpoint with ?ticket=<ticket> — the ticket is consumed atomically on first use and expires after WS_TICKET_TTL_SECONDS seconds if unused (default: 15 s; configure via settings.ws_ticket_ttl_seconds).
